name: Mohamed Light
bio: Egypt’s Mohamed Tarek returns to the world stage with the 2026 Season 1 golden ticket. A CRL world champion in 2022 and 2024.

name: Pedro
bio: Brazilian competitor Pedro Elias represents SKCalalas. He secured his place in Shanghai by winning CRL’s second season of 2026.

name: SandBox
bio: South Korea’s Kim Seoung-Jin, known as SandBox, plays for SKCalalas. The Season 3 winner brings another golden ticket to the World Finals.

name: Clown
bio: A Korean-American competitor representing Oddyssey. Clown claimed the Season 4 golden ticket to book a place among the final 16.

name: Mugi
bio: Japanese star and Crazy Raccoon player Mugi won the 2021 and 2023 CRL World Finals. He qualified this year through Season 5.

name: Sub
bio: A Brazilian competitor representing SKCalalas. Sub earned a World Finals berth through the 2026 season leaderboard.

name: adriel
bio: Adriel Eduardo is a Dominican competitor playing for WeSports. His season leaderboard finish earned him a spot in Shanghai.

name: Ryley
bio: Canadian competitor and Clash Royale creator Ryley qualified through the season leaderboard. He previously played for Olimpo Squad.

name: Vitor75
bio: Portugal’s Vitor Sousa competes as Vitor75 for Vatic Esports. He joins the World Finals field through the 2026 season leaderboard.

name: Guriko
bio: A Japanese competitor also known as Griko. Guriko previously played for SKCalalas and secured a berth through the season leaderboard.

name: Morten
bio: Germany’s Morten Mehmert is a long-standing SK Gaming competitor and the 2022 CRL runner-up. He qualified through the season leaderboard.

name: Viiper
bio: A French competitor representing Joblife. Viiper earned a place among the final 16 through the 2026 season leaderboard.

name: Woo
bio: A South Korean qualifier who earned one of the two World Finals tickets available at the Last Chance Qualifier. Further biography is not yet available in the cited roster.

name: JorZ
bio: A Spanish competitor representing SKCalalas. JorZ came through the Last Chance Qualifier to secure a spot in Shanghai.

name: Hermit
bio: A Chinese competitor who qualified through the Clash Royale Champions Cup. Further biography is not yet available in the cited roster.

name: Midnight
bio: A Chinese competitor who claimed a World Finals place through the Clash Royale Champions Cup. Further biography is not yet available in the cited roster.
